findings.title: Producer and judge reservations are shape-checked but not bound to the governing ledger
evidence: Producer and judge receipt validation accepts any reference with a 40-hex commit, nonempty path and 64-hex digest.
The referenced bytes are not loaded or parsed; attemptId, session, phase, allocation/partition, units, quota state, reservation-before-dispatch and retry lineage are not verified.
The synthetic fixtures use a fabricated reservation reference and still exercise successful import/rebuild paths.
The campaign criterion AC-08 requires one reservation/ledger to govern production, evaluation, retries and concurrent calls.
required_correction: S1 freezes a successor production allocation and the exact reservation/settlement event contract.
The importer preserves the original reservation/ledger bytes, verifies the reference digest and binds attemptId, session, phase, allocation/partition and quantity.
Producer, J1 and J2 use allowed distinct phases under the same campaign envelope; exhausted, duplicate, conflicting, late and unsettled attempts HOLD.
The rebuild path reuses the same verifier; it must not implement a parallel economic authority.
required_cases: uncertain prior attempt and authorized retry lineage
judge reservation bound to the appointed reviewer epoch

findings.title: Initial producer task and visible captured context are not part of the frozen per-entry recipe identity
evidence: NativeOwnershipPlan entries bind key/title/need/inputs/dependencies/navigation but contain no per-entry task or recipe identity.
The original producer request is accepted when task is merely nonempty; equality with a frozen task is not checked.
The request binds input versions but has no required mechanically verified capture map tying the visible source bytes/member records supplied to the producer to those versions.
The native rebuild proposal already demonstrates the stronger pattern: task and recipe contract are frozen and request captures are persisted.
required_correction: Freeze a per-entry recipe/task identity in the S1 scope/interface contract and include it in the plan hash.
Require the original producer request to equal that frozen task and to reference the exact captured source bodies/member records consumed.
Preserve capture CAS references and replay validation before binding a candidate.
Recipe/task or capture change must invalidate reuse even when the resulting prose is equal.
required_cases: different task under the same plan
identical task and exact captured context replay

findings.title: Historical source compatibility proves blob bytes but not Git tree mode equivalence
evidence: Historical source-freeze rows are validated as path plus sourceSha256 and compared to current bytes.
The preserved semantic-source comparison explicitly describes its mode as Git blob identity.
Git blob identity does not encode tree mode; the extended source capture proposal separately records mode for source entries.
required_resolution: S1/S5 determine whether executable/symlink mode is part of each reused source contract.
If relevant, bind historical and current tree mode and reject mismatch.
If deliberately irrelevant for a source class, preserve that limitation as an explicit gap rather than claiming full source equivalence.
findings.claim_boundary: No actual mode mismatch was observed; the missing evidence prevents a stronger equivalence claim.

All four proposals remain private; none publishes, mutates the serving projection or grants host authority.
